title: The 2026 Google Statistics Report: Search, Ads & Users
snippet:
# The 2026 Google Statistics Report: Search, Ads & Users

Our definitive 2026 report on Google statistics. Discover key data on search volume, user behavior, CTR, AI Overviews, ad revenue, and more.

## Google Statistics: AI, Clicks & The New SERP in 2026 [...] On one hand, Google remains a digital titan, commanding an 89.57% global market share . On the other hand, it is experiencing its most significant annual decline in a decade, especially on desktop, where competitors like Bing have grown their presence by over 151% in the last ten years . Beneath this top-line tension, fundamental user behaviors are being reshaped. [...] Even in the highly competitive North American market, Chrome maintains a clear majority with a 53.1% share .

## Google Cloud and Google Play

Beyond its consumer-facing products, Google is a heavyweight in enterprise infrastructure and the mobile app economy.
